evidence.reason: The fixture's git helper still calls subprocess.run with only cwd and no sanitized environment. Inherited GIT_DIR, GIT_INDEX_FILE, or GIT_WORK_TREE can override cwd and make git init/add/commit/rev-parse act on the caller's repository or index instead of the temporary fixture; the CLI child has the same inherited-environment risk. This is a hermeticity bug in existing test behavior, not a request for new scope. The supplied current code still shows the issue, and no contract clause or accepted limitation covers it.
